Both are tumour-suppressor genes in the homologous-recombination repair (HRR) pathway for double-strand DNA breaks — loss of repair drives carcinogenesis and underlies
NICE CG164 · RISK CATEGORIES (LIFETIME RISK FROM AGE 20)
Routine NHS screening from 50; no extra surveillance
Genetic testing is offered when the combined BRCA1/BRCA2 carrier probability is ≥10%. MRI surveillance (below) starts at a >30% carrier probability — a different threshold from testing.
SURVEILLANCE · WHO GETS WHAT, AND WHEN
OFFER if high risk; CONSIDER if moderate risk.
Tamoxifen — VTE and endometrial cancer risk.

Offer HRT to the age of natural menopause.
SYSTEMIC TREATMENT & THE WIDER GENE PANEL
Olaparib — adjuvant in high-risk HER2-negative BRCA-mutated early breast cancer (OlympiA trial); ‘synthetic lethality’ in
TP53 (Li-Fraumeni), PTEN (Cowden), CDH1 (lobular breast + diffuse gastric), STK11 (Peutz-Jeghers).
BRCA is autosomal dominant — a PATERNAL family history counts just as much; never dismiss cancers on the father’s side.
BRCA1 breast cancers are typically triple-negative / basal and high-grade — ‘ER-negative’ does not mean ‘not hereditary’.
Genetic testing is offered at ≥10% carrier probability, but MRI surveillance at >30% — two different thresholds.
Risk-reducing BSO lowers ovarian AND breast risk and must remove the tubes too — offer HRT until the age of natural
In TP53 / Li-Fraumeni avoid mammography (radiosensitivity) — surveil with MRI.
A negative predictive test in a family with a KNOWN variant is truly reassuring; an uninformative test in an untested family is
Sources: NICE CG164 — Familial breast cancer: classification, care and managing risk (2013, updated 2019). NHS Genomics Education Programme — BRCA1 & BRCA2 penetrance
estimates (Kuchenbaecker et al.). OlympiA trial (adjuvant olaparib, Tutt et al., NEJM 2021).
Key numbers: BRCA1 breast ~72% / ovarian ~44%; BRCA2 breast ~69% / ovarian ~17%. Risk bands — near-population <17%, moderate 17–30%, high ≥30% lifetime. Testing at ≥10%
carrier probability; annual MRI 30–49 for carriers.
